title: vehicle_map
description: The `vehicle_map` content kind (megaplan 1.7, 1.12, tasks 5-A2 and 5-F1): which of the 12 vehicle figure models a Night City vehicle is drawn as, and its default colour. One row per file. A vehicle matches a row when every match key the row has holds: `vc` (the `npcs` entry's `vc`, "<type>/<model>" from 2.31 Vehicle_Record.Type() and Model(), e.g. "Car/Turbo"), `type` (the part of `vc` before the slash: Car, Bike, Panzer) and `faction` (the vehicle's Affiliation().EnumName(), 2.31 `gamedataAffiliation`, when the figure carries one). A key's value is one name or a list of names (any of them). Of the matching rows the highest `priority` (default 0) wins, then the row with more match keys, then the lowest id. A row with no match keys matches every vehicle (the shipped `default` row: an unknown vehicle is a sedan in the Car class colour). `model` is the figure model (textures `cyberblock:textures/entity/vehicle/<model>.png`, `<model>_detail.png`, see art/gen_vehicle_art.py for the UV layout); `colour` (#RRGGBB) tints the model's paint layer when the host sends no `col`; with `keepColour` true the row's colour is used even when it does (liveries such as the police cruiser). A file with the same id as a default replaces it.
